name: markdown-field
title: Markdown field
description: A writing box with a small toolbar and a live preview: bold, italic, link, lists, quote and code, with shortcuts and no editor library.
docs: value, defaultValue and onValueChange speak plain Markdown text. toolbar lists the buttons to show (bold, italic, link, bulleted-list, numbered-list, quote, code; all by default) and the shortcuts Ctrl or Cmd with B, I and K follow it. A button wraps or prefixes the selection and takes the syntax off again when it is already there; with nothing selected, bold and italic work on the word at the caret, and the link button writes [link text](https://) with the part to fill in selected. The list and quote buttons act on every line the selection touches (a bulleted line becomes numbered when you press the numbered button), and Enter inside a list starts the next item, or ends the list on an empty one. The edits go through the browser's own editing (insertText), so Undo undoes a button; where that is not available the text is set directly and the selection restored. rows, maxLength (with a counter) and every other textarea prop such as id, name and aria-label go to the textarea, and defaultTab="preview" opens on the preview. The text stays mounted behind the preview, so a form still posts it. The preview is the exported Markdown component (markdown-field/markdown): it renders headings (a # becomes h2, so a page keeps its own h1; headingLevel changes that), bold and italic, links (http, https, mailto, tel, paths and anchors only), bulleted and numbered lists, quotes, inline code and fenced code as React elements, keeps single line breaks and never produces raw HTML. A link to a script or a data address is not made a link: it stays on the page as the plain text that was written. Lists are one level deep, so an indented item is shown flat. Use it wherever the saved text is shown again. applyAction and continueList are exported from markdown-field/edit for buttons of your own.
